tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find upcoming commercial real estate conferences (2026-2027) by sector, place, date, price or keyword. Every event was checked against the organizer's own site; results include dates, city, venue, posted prices, who attends, why to go, deadlines and links.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full record for one event by id (ids come from search_events), including community takes on whether it is worth attending when we have them.

tools.name: compare_events
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 events on dates, place, price, size, audience, sectors and who it suits. Use ids from search_events.

tools.name: upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: Early-bird, hotel and registration deadlines in the next N days, soonest first, each with the event, organizer and registration link.

tools.name: recommend_for_role
tools.description: The short list of upcoming CRE conferences for a role (lenders, investors, brokers, developers, multifamily, property-managers, proptech), each with why it suits that role, then other matching events. Optional filters narrow by date, place or price.

tools.name: calendar_subscription_link
tools.description: Create a personal, auto-updating calendar feed for the given filters (or a list of event ids) and return one-click links for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and Outlook. Each call stores a new feed record (filters only, no personal data). Give the links to the user.
